name: @odu/run-history
//: THE DURABLE RUN CATALOG — see README.md, which argues the boundary. This package owns what outlives a coordinator: the per-user catalog, the ordered journal, immutable per-attempt evidence, the ownership fence, and the one attention query every face asks. It depends on @odu/run-client (the wire vocabulary a run speaks) and on nothing else of odu, so `execution` and `cli` can both read history without either importing the other.
//dependencies: `@odu/run-client` is a workspace sibling, and the arrow runs one way: run-history → run-client, never back. `effect` must stay at the version the rest of the tree resolves (the root `overrides` pins it) — two copies give Effect's _tag-based narrowing two class realms to disagree about, and the symptom is a decode failure on a well-formed record. src/closure.test.ts walks the import graph to keep both facts true.
